newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul names Richard Snell chairman.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul names Richard Snell chairman.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp said Monday its board of directors elected Richard Snell as chairman, president and chief executive officer.
Snell has been employed by Tenneco Inc since 1987 and as president and chief executive officer of Tenneco Automotive since 1993.

Snell replaces Roderick Hills as chairman and Robert "Steve" Miller who served as acting chief executive officer. Hills and Miller, long-time members of the board, were elected to their positions on September 17, 1996, when the previous chairman and chief executive officer, Dennis Gormley, resigned.

At Tenneco Automotive, Snell oversaw revenue growth from $1.8 billion in 1993 to an anticipated $3 billion in 1996, fueled by an aggressive global expansion program and strong market share growth in its aftermarket brands, Federal-Mogul said.

"His (Snell's) outstanding reputation and experience in the global auto parts industry, as both a manufacturer and an aftermarket distributor, are tailor made for the management of Federal-Mogul's assets," Hills said in a statement.

Federal-Mogul is a $2 billion global distributor and manufacturer of a broad range of non-discretionary parts primarily for automobiles, light trucks, heavy trucks, and farm and construction vehicles.
